sources.excerpt: keeping and its claim for a permanent seat in the Security Council. 26.1 Basic Objectives and Principles of Foreign Policy Preservation of national interest, achievement of world peace, disarmament, independence for Afro-Asian nations have been important objectives of India’s foreign policy. These objectives are sought to be achieved through some principles viz. Panchsheel; non- alignment; anti-colonialism, anti-imperialism, anti-racism, and strengthening the UN. It would be befitting to expand these principles. 26.1.1 Panchsheel
